name: typesafe-mcp
description: Structured AI decisions via TypeSafe AI's Jev System One model - typed routing, scoring, and verification judgments, not chat.
long_description: Provides AI assistants and agents with typed judgment primitives from TypeSafe AI's Jev System One model. Jev is not a chat/coding-agent LLM - it answers typed Choice/Score/Noul questions against a caller-supplied state and returns typed answers with probabilities, never free text. Reachable through two independent providers: the direct API (console.typesafe.ai) or OpenRouter's Decisions API (openrouter.ai) - both fully supported standalone paths, auto-resolved from whichever credential is configured. Exposes three tools: typesafe_status (credential/provider diagnostics, no credentials required), typesafe_decide (the core judgment call), and typesafe_list_models (model discovery, live for the direct provider, static for OpenRouter since it publishes no discovery endpoint).

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Direct-provider key from console.typesafe.ai. Optional if typesafe_openrouter_api_key is set instead - OpenRouter is a fully supported standalone path, not a fallback, for when console.typesafe.ai is unreachable.

typesafe_base_url.title: TypeSafe base URL
typesafe_base_url.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the default (https://api.typesafe.ai/v1). Only set this for a staging or sovereign shard.

typesafe_openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
typesafe_openrouter_api_key.description: OpenRouter key, used only for the Jev Decisions path (POST https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions). Optional if typesafe_api_key is set instead.

typesafe_openrouter_base_url.title: OpenRouter base URL
typesafe_openrouter_base_url.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the default (https://openrouter.ai/api).

typesafe_provider.title: TypeSafe provider
typesafe_provider.description: Optional: typesafe | openrouter | auto. Leave blank for auto (prefers typesafe_api_key if set, else typesafe_openrouter_api_key).

typesafe_model.title: TypeSafe model override
typesafe_model.description: Optional. For provider typesafe, used verbatim (default jev-latest). For provider openrouter, a bare slug with no "/" is auto-prefixed with "~typesafe/" as a convenience (default ~typesafe/jev-latest).
